body:
Real progress toward founder's bot-league training ask (SECTION 459).

S459-43: Added a real round timer to MODE_QUEUE (SERVER_QUEUE_FRAG_LIMIT=20,
SERVER_QUEUE_ROUND_MS=4min), mirroring the existing DM round-check pattern
but without a map reload (QUEUE always plays the one admin-flagged default
level).

S459-44: Found and fixed a real, previously-undiscovered protocol bug in
emily-bot's PacketSnapshot decode -- it assumed a legacy 18-byte entity
layout starting at offset 2; the real wire format (12-byte NetHeader + 1
count byte + 64-byte NetPlayer entries from offset 13, confirmed via a
compiled sizeof/offsetof probe) meant every peer position/health/weapon the
bot ever read had been garbage. Fixed with a byte-exact unit test.

S459-45: Built the requested 50-100 hand-engineered feature observation
vector -- 72 real, named features (23 self, 4x10 nearest-opponent,
9 aggregate), self-relative framing, no padding. Found that
packages/common/physics.h already computes a real, dense,
server-authoritative reward signal per player (+150/kill, +0.5/damage-point)
that reaches the wire as NetPlayer.reward_feedback -- never decoded before
this work.

S459-46: Built the requested reward system (4 tiers: outcome via the real
reward_feedback signal, low-health disengage shaping, survival, engagement),
FFA-only per the founder's own instruction, with team rewards architected
via a real, typed TeamRewardContext parameter (genuine no-op today).

Full design doc: SHANKPIT/docs/BOT_TRAINING_NORTHSTAR.md.

Live-verified: full go test ./... green (7 new tests), a real 2-bot UDP
session against a rebuilt server with no panics and correct peer counts,
live server + bot pool both redeployed with the fixed/extended binaries.

Commits: SHANKPIT@10a9d7b (round timer), SHANKPIT@9fa2a32 (decode fix +
observation + reward).

⚓ ☃
title: S459-43/44/45/46: QUEUE round timer, real PacketSnapshot decode fix, 72-feature bot observation + reward system
